esschacht12.name: Zollverein
esschacht12.slogan: A Bauhaus coal mine that now holds a museum and a skating rink.
esschacht12.line: The last coal was cut on 23 December 1986; UNESCO made Zollverein a World Heritage Site in 2001.

esdulandschaftspark.name: Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord
esdulandschaftspark.slogan: Rust, ferns and floodlights where iron once poured.
esdulandschaftspark.line: Divers swim in an old gasholder and climbers scale the ore-bunker walls of this former Thyssen ironworks.

esosgasometer.name: Gasometer Oberhausen
esosgasometer.slogan: A steel drum 117 metres tall, hollowed out for art.
esosgasometer.line: In 1992 Oberhausen's council voted to buy the gasholder by a single vote; it reopened as an exhibition hall in 1994.

estigerturtle.name: Tiger & Turtle
estigerturtle.slogan: Climb a rollercoaster that never leaves the ground.
estigerturtle.line: Opened in 2011 on Heinrich-Hildebrand-Höhe, this walkable steel coaster stops short of its loop, which cannot be climbed.

esvillahuegel.name: Villa Hügel
esvillahuegel.slogan: The Krupp family's hilltop home above the Ruhr.
esvillahuegel.line: Alfred Krupp's villa has 269 rooms and was built in 1870-73 with double-paned windows and an early form of air conditioning.
